W.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Mother-of-pearl sheets 5; na-cre-ous light on cold air 7; dawn the sky holds, brief 5); accurate nacreous clouds but stock 'mother-of-pearl' and a slightly muddled last line.

X.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Cold cup on the sill 5; the lens cloud over the ridge 7; holds still, wind running 5); lenticular cloud is evoked but the cup image is disconnected and the ending is cryptic.

Y.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Cloud lens on the ridge 5; all the wind pours through it, still 7; and the smell of snow 5); the lenticular cloud holding still while wind pours through it is true and the smell of snow is a fresh turn.

Z.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Nacreous glow burns 5; in the long dark before dawn 7; mother-of-pearl sky 5); accurate to polar stratospheric clouds but 'glow burns' is imprecise and the close is stock phrasing.
